messages.subject: Record Table Error
parts:
Has anybody encountered this error before. For reference I have 19700 pictures to process
 
[ reached getOption("max.print") -- omitted 4982 rows ]
Warning message:
In system(command.tmp, intern = TRUE) :
  running command 'exiftool -q -f -t -r -Directory -FileName -EXIF:DateTimeOriginal -HierarchicalSubject -ext JPG "F:/Renamed PreSwap/Nisha"' had status 1 



It looks like it processed all of them except one of my folders that contains 4982 pictures. Any idea how to override this?

I'd have a look at the folder name, and more likely at the Hierarchical tags in the unprocessed images to see how they differer in structure and containing the extra characters beyond the alphabet and numbers.
